name: app-smart-ring-health-app-orange-and-cream
title: Smart ring health app in cream with orange heatmap and voice orb
whatItIs: Three phones on cream: a home with a photo of a ring on driftwood and a recovery curve card, a sleep heatmap grid in orange-to-lime with a wave overlay and stat cards, and a voice screen with a translucent orange swirl and waveform.
whatItMeans: Warm, calm and premium; orange on cream feels energising without clinical coldness.
techniques: Show sleep data as a grid of rounded squares graded from orange to green.
Overlay a smooth wave line on the heatmap.
Use a translucent 3D swirl as the voice assistant emblem.
Pair a real product photo with a chart card.
Use a dark pill tab bar with an orange active state.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of cells coloured by value.
A graphic of audio amplitude bars.
A translucent 3D shape representing an AI.
A selected tab shown as a coloured capsule.
